analysis.overall: The day featured a stretch of overnight lows followed by stubborn midday spikes, complicated by periods of pump connectivity issues.

events.title: Overnight low
events.description: Glucose drifted down to a low of 55 mg/dL around dawn, staying under 70 mg/dL for a couple of hours.

events.title: Morning rebound
events.description: After recovering from the low, glucose climbed rapidly with a double-up trend before a series of corrections brought it back down.

events.title: Midday spike
events.description: Glucose shot up to 212 mg/dL with a double-up trend following a meal, requiring aggressive correction boluses over the next hour.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on pump connectivity and overnight trends to catch lows earlier.
